notes.title: New Units, Map Update & Monster Buff II
notes.content:
Hello, bold destroyers of the Empire!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/ba194cac9471d1c46d4b81b9d4f3157d78b3ff9e.png[/img]

We've updated the campaign map, adding a second bonus level (the Oasis) plus made some alternative swamp levels into new fully separate ones.

Our monster cat has received further buffs, especially to various upgrades. Melee attack hit boxes have been made a little bigger, all negative status durations have been reduced, and the visual effects of being poisoned do not alter camera view any more.

The imperial forces have been boosted by 7 new types of variety units. They have already joined imperial armies in various levels throughout the campaign, here are some details of 5 of them:

The Imperial Cook
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/124237c30588b2b27427d8dee20be7d56d76c287.png[/img]

The Living Metal Axehead Rammer
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/2e2f1089f02c2fce43eb59ab76164d5689114638.png[/img]

The Bear Hunter
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/e0848b46e0ab8d59c5ee7f3489d6d1b1b363a4e0.png[/img]

The Golden Zweihander
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/986643001ac2519720629205f3b5dfdd11b5c9c6.png[/img]

The Elder Noble
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/af4f1174aed5263fe454c827ad3700717e642e93.png[/img]

Additionally, the barbarian warrior weapon was replaced with a long war billhook, about twice as long as their previous trident.

More variety units are in the works.

P.S. a bit of background lore:
The monster cat never cared the slightest about what names the humans give to their empire or any other forces of greed & domination. The cat knows the name is just another fancy label for something simply bad. That's why the Empire is consistently called "the empire" (with a noncapital e) in the game, and that's why it's specific name is never mentioned.

notes.title: Monster Run: Downfall of the Empire is now Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone!
[/h3]

Monster Run: Downfall of the Empire was released a little over two weeks ago, and it’s been an incredibly exciting time for the entire team here at Interactive Fate. [b]Today, we’re approaching you with a friendly request and an announcement that we’re super stoked about![/b]

[h5][u]The Request[/u][/h5]

Once again, I want to thank every single one of you for picking up Monster Run! This game is very much a passion project, and I’m thrilled that it’s finally out and I get to [b]read about your experiences and feedback[/b]. 

Steam reviews are not only a great way for devs to grasp an audience’s feelings about a game and improve it. They’re also the [b]best and easiest way for the community to help smaller studios[/b] reach more people! On that note, if you’ve played Monster Run and haven’t had the chance to leave a review: please do! [b]We’d love to know what you liked and what left you [i]feline[/i] unsure.[/b]

[h5][u]The Amazing News[/u][/h5]

Now to some great news: As an avid handheld gamer, I’m proud to announce that[b] Monster Run: Downfall of the Empire is now [u][b]Verified[/b][/u] on Steam Deck! [/b]

You’ll be able to play the game hassle-free from the comfort of your couch, friend's home, towering human empire fortress, and anywhere else! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/729484b54d54559e32843f1be8fd165bab3ecfb7.png[/img]
[i]Image 1. Steam Deck verified![/i]

Get ready to destroy the empire and reclaim the forests that the puny humans have so carelessly taken from us [b]on the go.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/c9c54eb26ac0d5c719dd7c979f3875a050b179e9.jpg[/img]
[i]Image 2. Monster Run on the go![/i]

That’s it for this blog! I’m very much[b] looking forward to reading your reviews[/b]. And if you happen to play Monster Run on your Steam Deck, [b]feel free to post a picture and tag us on Twitter or Discord[/b] - we’d love to see our game out there in the wide world. 

- Edvin

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2394300/Monster_Run_Downfall_of_the_Empire/

notes.title: Monster Cat Buff, version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Thank you everyone who was bold enough to try the 1st version!

You're our heroes because you ventured into a hostile, unknown realm despite the well-known fact that fresh universes may come with glitches and oddities! Fortunately, no true deadly anomalies have been encountered so far...

We were worried the fine experience of crushing and slashing imperial footmen would be too easy, but turns out it was actually a little too deadly and rough - thank you for the fast feedback about this x)
Please let us kindly know in the discussion forum if you wish to propose further rebalances, the more specific (and the more kind) the better!

Today's update considerably buffed our monster cat - numerous fairly small but important boosts to attacks, stats (speed, HP, mana etc) and/or their upgrades, that together should make a considerable difference. Please make sure you have the new version 1.0.1 before playing to get all the monster buffs! 
Steam automatic game updates may sometimes behave a little stubbornly despite everyone's best intentions :') 

Additionally, pouncing/jumping now makes you properly immune to slowdown effects of the swamps.
We admit  it was like a bad dream where you're slowed down even when you're leaping through air while being chased by something unfriendly x') It's so much more enjoyable now to jump around in the puddles =^_^=

We're also creating some free extra content, more on that soon. 
The "Poisoned" status of the monster was designed to impair viewing the battlefield, but we will be changing its visual effects for greater accessibility.
We will be rebalancing and improving the game further after this update (together with new free content) as planned.

Quick tips to take with you:
1. All monster paw attacks can deflect incoming arrows (it takes a bit of practice)
2. Not moving after/while using the palm lightning spell (a high level magic) causes extra rays to appear one by one, increasing your magical attack power up to five times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/f9edd1332730854bcfe84a4e60b0009a61d1deb1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Monster Run: Downfall of the Empire is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[b]Monster Run: Downfall of the Empire[/b] is out now!

Check out this fresh trailer full of rampage and destruction:
[previewyoutube=KfIUjZixRgU;full][/previewyoutube]
As you're probably aware by now, Monster Run is a dark fantasy roguelite'ish beat-em-up where you're a giant fire breathing monster cat, personally fighting vs large medieval armies.

After waking from a 100-year sleep and seeing how the new greedy human empire ravages your forests and lands, you’ve decided to personally obliterate it. Demolish its castles, kings, armies comprised of hundreds of soldiers, and every other last piece of imperial might.

Here are some of the features you can expect:
[list]

[/list]
We hope you enjoy exploring the world of Monster Run: Downfall of the Empire as much as we loved creating it!

notes.title: Monster Run: Downfall of the Empire - Launch FAQ!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

With the launch of Monster Run: Downfall of the Empire in a few hours, we wanted to answer some frequently asked questions about the game!

[b]What genre is this game?[/b]
It’s a dark fantasy beat’em up with roguelite elements and an evolving map! This means that when you start a new run, some missions will be switched with a new alternative mission.

[b]What’s the story of Monster Run?[/b]
Monster Run thrusts you into the role of a house-sized fire-breathing monster cat. After waking from a 100-year sleep and seeing how the new greedy human empire ravages your forests and lands, you’ve decided to personally obliterate this empire, demolish its castles, kings, armies comprised of hundreds of soldiers, and every other last piece of imperial might.

[b]What specifically makes Monster Run unique?[/b]
It's currently the only game in the world where you can be a giant firebreathing monster cat, pitted against medieval-style armies of human soldiers.

Most beat-em-ups have followed a tried and trusted formula, with limited innovation—usually featuring a small hero battling hordes of enemies and taking down massive bosses. We felt that this concept had been thoroughly explored, so we wanted to flip the script.

In Monster Run: Downfall of the Empire, we wanted to allow the player to become bigger and stronger for a change, to literally crush fortifications and walls piece by piece and lay waste to entire armies. While the game retains the classical beat-em-up mechanics focused on close combat tactics and hand-to-hand fighting, we amplified the experience with a little firebreathing every now and then, of course.

[b]When is the exact release of the game?[/b]
Tuesday, August 27th, 2024 at 5pm CEST/8pm PET!

[b]What platforms will the game be on?[/b]
It’ll be available on Steam! We plan to port Monster Run onto other platforms soon.

[b]Will there be controller support?[/b]
Yes! Both Xbox and Playstation controllers can be used to play the game, as well as other similar controllers out there.You’ll only need a keyboard if you’d like to name your monster cat.

[b]What game engine was Monster Run built on?[/b]
Monster Run was made on Unity3D.

[b]Will keys be rebindable in the game?[/b]
Yes, most keys and controls will be rebindable within the game.

[b]What languages will be available on release?[/b]
It’ll be available in 9 languages, including English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.


We hope this FAQ answers some of your questions! And if you have any other questions not cover here, feel free to let us know through [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2394300/discussions/]Steam’s Discussion board[/url], or on our [url=https://discord.gg/iceberginteractive]Discord[/url]!

Thank you, and we can’t wait for the release on August 27th!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2394300/Monster_Run_Downfall_of_the_Empire/

notes.content:

Hey everyone, 

Unlike our titular monster, we haven’t been hibernating. We’ve been working hard on getting the game into the best possible shape, and we’re more than excited for all of you to get another taste of what we’ve been building over the past few months, which is why [b]we’re back with a brand-new demo for Monster Run!
